title: The Blue Cove Oasis | 8 Bedroom 7 Bathroom 17+Beds
description: Your private boutique resort in the heart of Scottsdale. This 8,700 sq ft mansion features 17 beds (no bunks), 7 full bathrooms, and upscale amenities, making it ideal for large groups, golf trips, family reunions, and celebrations. 5 minutes from the Waste Management Open & Barrett-Jackson Car Auction, and 10 minutes from Old Town, Top Golf, Talking Stick, and PHX Airport. This home delivers a one-of-a-kind desert escape with room to relax, play, and entertain.
